subject: Hispanic Heritage Month Celebration
overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn announced the city's upcoming Hispanic Heritage Month celebration and introduced municipal liaisons providing resident support services.

items.title: Hispanic Heritage Month Celebration
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn announced the city's Hispanic Heritage Month celebration scheduled for Sunday at the Andrews Middle School.

items.title: Community Liaison and Connector Services
items.summary: Spanish Community Liaison Jennifer Alvarez and Community Connector Lisette Carteiro outlined available municipal assistance, including support for MassHealth applications, housing, food pantry access, and language line services.
